Kyrgyzstan
Consular help: Consular help will be provided by the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Moscow, Russia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular biometric passport NO up to 30 days
Service/Official biometric passport NO up to 30 days
Diplomatic biometric passport NO up to 30 days
Citizens of the Kyrgyz Republic require a visa to enter, exit or transit through the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visas are issued in Moscow, Russian Federation.
Security conditions: Moderately unstable area. There is a risk of travel due to the current unstable political situation and high crime rate
Risk zone: City of Osh and border areas in Uzbekistan and Tajikistan
Foreign exchange: Local currency: som; 1 USD = 38.99 som
Vaccines: Hepatitis A and B, tetanus
Risk of malaria in the areas of Batken, Osh and Jalalabad. Do not drink running water or eat unpeeled and fresh fruits and vegetables, as well as meat from the market and other perishable foods. Tuberculosis is widespread. The tendency is for sexually transmitted diseases to increase.
Medicines are available only in the capital cities.
Drugs: Penalties of up to 20 years in prison
Area code: ++996 312
